html: Phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K) makes the lipid PIP3, which recruits PDK1 and AKT to the membrane, where PDK1 activates AKT. PIP3 also helps recruit phospholipase Cγ, which cleaves PIP2 into the second messengers DAG and IP3. IP3 releases calcium from the endoplasmic reticulum, and DAG with calcium activates conventional protein kinase C isoforms such as PKCβ; novel isoforms such as PKCδ need DAG only. AKT and PKC both feed the IKK complex that activates NF-κB.
